deadletter.resend.append: This stream appends. A resend skips rows whose BigQuery load job already landed, refuses jobs still running, and refuses rows with no job unless given --allow-duplicates: those could be written twice.
deadletter.resend.merge: This stream merges: the dedup key makes a resent row that already landed a no-op. A resend still skips jobs that landed and refuses jobs still running.
deadletter.resend.other: This destination has no merge: a resend delivers the rows again, so whoever consumes them has to be idempotent on ingestion_id, which the rows keep.
deadletter.unreadable: gateway deadletter reads back only a files dead letter (a directory, gs:// or s3://); this one is read with the destination's own tools.
